meta.name: esm
meta.description: Use when working directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 运行 ESM 模型进行蛋白质结构预测与推理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要预测蛋白质结构或运行 ESM 模型推理。
copy.tagline_en: Predict protein structures and run ESM model inference
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to predict protein structures or run ESM model inference.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能直接围绕 ESM 蛋白质语言模型写 Python 代码:用 ESM3 生成或补全蛋白质序列、预测结构、按结构反向设计序列,或用 ESM C 计算蛋白质嵌入向量。
howto.when: 当用户直接提到 esm Python SDK、ESM3/ESMC 模型 ID,或要求使用 Forge/Biohub 推理客户端、ESMFold2 折叠流程时触发。

say.text: 用 ESMC 计算这几条序列的嵌入向量,用于相似度比较。
say.note: Claude 会写 ESMC 编码脚本并返回嵌入。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can write Python code using the ESM SDK for protein language models: generating or completing sequences with ESM3, predicting structures, inverse folding, and computing embeddings with ESM C, including Forge/Biohub hosted clients.
howto.when_en: Triggered when working directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

say_en.text: Complete this protein sequence with esm3-open: MPRT___KEND, using underscores for masked positions.
say_en.note: Claude will return the completed sequence from ESM3.

say_en.text: Use ESMC to compute embeddings for these sequences for similarity comparison.
say_en.note: Claude will run an ESMC encoding script and return embeddings.

say_en.text: Predict the 3D structure of this sequence with ESM3's structure track and output PDB.
say_en.note: Claude will run structure prediction and provide coordinates or PDB.
